Title: LinkedIn Learning and LMS Deep Integration Overview

Blocks.Section: LinkedIn Learning and LMS Deep Integration Overview
Blocks.Text: The below configuration guides focus on LinkedIn Learning LMS Integration Partners. This group of enterprise partners is fluid, and may grow on an as-needed basis.

Blocks.Section: LinkedIn Learning and LMS Deep Integration Overview
Blocks.Text: LinkedIn Learning partners with a number of LMS providers to make learning easy for your admins and seamless for your learners. Integration with LinkedIn Learning offers admins a deep content library in which to administer learner activity, enroll participants, and report on learner progress and content preferences. In LinkedIn Learning, learners have direct access to their courses and administrators can blend custom content with LinkedIn Learning content to create unique learning experiences.

Blocks.Section: LinkedIn Learning and LMS Deep Integration Overview
Blocks.Text: Partner LMS integrations fall into three categories:

Blocks.Section: LinkedIn Learning and LMS Deep Integration Overview
Blocks.Text:
Catalog Sync and AICC Reporting
Catalog Sync and xAPI Reporting
Defined Solutions

LinkedIn Learning and LMS Deep Integration Overview
Blocks.Text: Learn more about LinkedIn Learning’s partnerships with various SSO providers that make account activation and access easier for admins and learners.

Blocks.Section: LinkedIn Learning and LMS Deep Integration Overview
Blocks.Text: By leveraging LMS partnerships, you can achieve the following objectives:

Blocks.Section: LinkedIn Learning and LMS Deep Integration Overview
Blocks.Text:
Reduce your and your admins' manual workload by enabling automatic uploads of LinkedIn Learning content into your LMS.
Give your learners seamless access to Learning content via your LMS.
Add learner progress and course completion data directly back to your LMS.

Blocks.Section: LinkedIn Learning and LMS Deep Integration Overview
Blocks.Text: Deep integration of external systems with LinkedIn Learning enables APIs to dynamically refresh the content library on a daily basis, as opposed to requiring admins to manually upload new content to their learning platforms.
